brands.name: Fishstix Surfboards
brands.location_label: St. Francis Bay, Eastern Cape, South Africa
brands.short_description: Premium hand-shaped surfboards by Simon Fish in St. Francis Bay — performance shortboards, twins, fishes, and mid-lengths refined at Jeffreys Bay and the Eastern Cape.

models.name: Surf Punk
models.description: The Surf Punk is our flagship high-performance model. Its constant evolution over two decades sees it stand at the forefront of performance and progression. The board will continuously engage the power of the wave through hard and committed surfing. If progressive and high-performance surfing is what excites you and you need a board that can handle anything you paddle into, the Surf Punk is a go.

models.name: Keeper
models.description: If you are into fast, smooth surfing on the rail, then the Keeper is the board to include in your quiver. The board features a continuous curve in the rocker and outline. This creates an excellent base to surf over your front and back foot through carves, while enabling you to surf vertically in the critical section of the wave. The board feels engaged down-the-line, while shifting your weight forward through turns gives it release and a loose feeling. Surfed as a quad or thruster.

models.name: White Gold 2.0
models.description: A lightning fast smaller wave performance board, which fits right in between your groveler and all-rounder. The lower entry rocker and fuller outline generates speed and drive in softer conditions, while the high hip placement creates a pivot point between the feet, which loosens the tail creating whip and release through turns. The bottom features a single to double concave through the fins, this assists in rail to rail transitioning, giving more control and a responsive feel under foot. Lower nose entry, high hip placement, squash or swallow tail.

models.name: The El Niño
models.description: Designed for powerful surf in the overhead to double overhead range. The El Niño is a product of many years surfing and shaping for surfers who love to have a go when winter kicks in! The wide point has been moved forward placing more volume under chest to increase paddling power and get you into those heaving waves early. The pulled-in rails and tail allow for navigating barrels and maintaining control during high-speed turns, without sacrificing the board's responsiveness.

models.name: The Honey Badger
models.description: Stanley Badger's signature board model. Designed and shaped in Simon's shaping bay, together, Simon and Stanley came up with an absolute small wave ripper with surprising capabilities in overhead surf. Goes flat out in anything from half-foot shorey to groomed overhead J-bay walls. Feels like a thruster in and out of the lip, but has the speed of a quad.

models.name: The Twinski
models.description: A contemporary take on the twin fin which altered the trajectory of modern surfing over four decades ago, the Twinski is a channel bottom twin fin ridden 3 to 4 inches shorter than your regular short board. The channels and subtle single concave provide drive and control while still maintaining that classic twin fin flow we are all accustomed to.

models.name: Mid-length Twinski
models.description: Following the success of the Twinski, we have created a mid-length version, hence the name Mid-length Twinski. The longer mid-length is a cruisey, user friendly version, designed for intermediate to advanced surfers looking to catch more waves and draw stylish lines on the open face of waves. The channels and larger twin fin setup creates hold and stability at speed. Ride 6 to 12 inches longer if you are a short-boarder looking to step onto a longer board.

models.name: The Long Fish
models.description: Cruise and draw classic lines on smaller days or catch waves with confidence when the surf picks up. The Long Fish is a board suitable for all skill levels. It can be surfed further forward when flowing down the line or looking for the tube, while stepping over the fins allows for easy redirecting and generating speed. There is plenty of foam in this cruiser to up your wave count and get you in early.

models.name: Nose Rose
models.description: The Nose-Rose is shaped for traditional nose-riding and trim. Various nose concaves and spoons are optional. The Nose Rose comes with a rolled vee through to the tail and 50/50 rails which allows for plenty of control on the nose, as well as tight arcs and direction changes when needed. We have added extra curve out the back of the board, which creates down-force in the tail and keeps you propped up on the nose.
